secrets.name: The Musicians' Gallery
secrets.text: Up the hidden stair, the musicians' gallery: chairs, music stands, a harp, a cello laid down mid-bar. The music on the stands is the tune that has been in your head since you came into the library. You never heard where it was coming from.

meta.label: The Ballroom
meta.blurb: The party is in full swing: the chandeliers blaze, the glasses are poured, the streamers are still falling. Nobody is dancing. In the mirror, just for a moment, somebody is.
